test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

The cashier had finished the assigned task on time.

options.text: The assigned task is finished by the cashier on time.
The assigned task has been finished by the cashier on time.
The assigned task had been finished by the cashier on time.
The assigned task was finished by the cashier on time.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "The cashier had finished the assigned task on time."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the assigned task" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "had finished" to "had been finished" (past perfect passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "the cashier."
 
• Ensure the time phrase "on time" remains at the end of the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The assigned task had been finished by the cashier on time."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The assigned task is finished by the cashier on time." – Incorrect tense (present simple passive).
 
• **Option 2: **"The assigned task has been finished by the cashier on time." – Incorrect tense (present perfect passive).
 
• **Option 4: **"The assigned task was finished by the cashier on time." – Incorrect tense (past simple passive).
